headline: Persona 4 Revival February 18
title: Persona 4 Revival Release Date February 18 | Atlus Remake | Gaming News
video_script: Persona four Revival launches on February eighteenth, twenty twenty seven. Atlus announced the date at the Xbox Games Showcase in June. The remake of the fan favourite Persona four comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC, and skips Nintendo Switch. Pre-orders are already open. Will you revisit Inaba? Comment below!
description: Persona 4 Revival (Atlus) launches February 18, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. Sources: Gematsu, RPG Site, Video Games Chronicle.
